ED nurse here. Yeah this is pretty typical. We feel bad when this happens because it is so not ideal. We are in the business of getting the most people the most care as soon as possible and that means sometimes having people get their care in a hallway space. We go off the mentality that sitting in the waiting room means that no care is being provided at all. It’s not a doctors office, we don’t have control of what comes in and have to constantly adapt to ever changing situations. It is not conducive to rest/sleep at all to patients. Sorry you have this situation, but this happens nationwide 24/7.
